locked_multidimensional_interpretation: M34 independently recurred as an ubiquitous latent transcriptional representation in a variable-only ortholog space selected without frozen-module membership. Because 153 of 155 detected M34 genes have negative loadings, M34 is best interpreted as an inverse immune-lineage or immune-depletion/exclusion axis.
